Principle1:Self-Introduction
Greeting and Introduction
Nice to meet you.
First of all, thank you for giving me a chance to introduce myself.
My name’s 홍길동, but you can call me Mr.홍.
My Personal and Educational Background
My name is 홍길동, and I live in 서울.
I live at 한국apartment with my wife and children.
I am 40 years old.
I graduated from 한국 High School.
I also attended 대한 University with a bachelor’s degree in English.
I have been working for cell-phone company for the past 10 years.
My Personality
I’m An Outgoing Person
Even though I’m a very outgoing person, I’m sometimes a little shy around new people.
I have a lot of friends who(m) I love to be around.
I’m a pretty happy person, so most people like me.
I’m A Shy Person
I’m kind of a shy person.
I am afraid I talk too much, but everyone says I am a very likeable person and fun to be around.
I’m a pretty happy person.
Most people like me after they get to know me.
My Hobbies
My hobbies include5 reading books, listening to music, hiking, watching movies and playing and watching sports, but I especially like hiking.
Volunteer Work
In my free time, I also like to help/helping other people.
I like to volunteer at the orphanage and help the children there at least once month.
